class.name: CbPrediction
class.brief_description: Shows the viewer's own key press at once, as the cue the server will send for it.
class.description: A mod's rules run on the server, so what a press did comes back a round trip later. A look can say what its own server is going to answer: when the viewer presses [member action] while [member conditions] hold, [member cue] plays for the viewer there and then, with the same [CbReaction] nodes the server's cue plays. No second reaction for the local player. When the server's cue of that name arrives for the viewer, it is the echo: the reactions that already played stay quiet, and the ones that had to wait play now. A reaction waits when it uses what only the server knows: it is placed at the cue's point, end or beam, a path of it starts with [code]$other[/code], or a condition reads [code]event.*[/code]. The conditions are the look's guess of the server's rule. A wrong guess is not taken back: the reaction played, and no server cue follows. What the server changes (ammo on the HUD, the swing's body pose) still comes with the server's answer. It goes anywhere under the [CbDirector]: in a world reactions scene, or in an item's scene.

members.member: The action whose press this predicts: one the server's mod declares ([code]fire[/code]).
The cue the server sends for that press ([code]pistol.fired[/code]). The same name, so the same reactions play.
All must hold on the viewer's own entity, written like a [CbReaction]'s: [code]pistol.gun[/code], [code]pistol.ammo > 0[/code], [code]!pistol.reloading[/code].
Seconds before the next press predicts again: the server's own rate (the pistol's 0.2 s between shots).
